title: Left or right
starting_code:
# One door is locked.
# Choose with if and else.
hints: There are two ways. A different door is locked in each. The same program must get through both.
Ask `left_door.locked`. Take the right door under the `if`. Take the left door under the `else`.
Walk to the door in each way. Use `open()`. Then move down and along to the stair.
intro: One of these doors is locked. It changes every night. We need a backup plan to go through.
outro: A backup plan works perfectly. You made a choice with two paths.
learned: Now you know how to run a backup plan with `else` when a condition is false.
